source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Start with the inspection date.
3. Then add who did the inspection.
4. Look at the inspection report.
5. Look at the item on the inspection report that failed.
6. Then look at the date it failed.
7. List the date and the item that failed.
8. Look at the notes on the item, what can be done for the issue.
9. Look at the assigned mitigation action on each item that failed.
10. Contact the person(s) who can take the assigned mitigation action(s).

This code snippet is an instruction manual written with just one line of code, using the GPT-3 technology from OpenAI. I will say the most detailed code I have created and I am very proud of myself!

It does not just look at the notes on the items that failed but on the whole inspection report. This is helpful if I were to complete the inspection in further
